method_note: 3-way Poisson match model. Strength = coarse FIFA-tier seed bands (labeled on every card) blended with in-tournament record elo; seed weight = 2/(2+matches played), so the tournament's own evidence takes over by the knockouts. Goals: ~2.6/match split by elo gap, independent Poisson grid -> 1X2 / over 2.5 / BTTS. The model runs FLAT, so the displayed pick is SHADED toward the de-vigged DraftKings line (the sharp market); the raw model prob is shown alongside as the divergence/learning signal. Fair odds are 0-vig off the displayed (sharp) probability.
